replacements.instruction: Remove the redundant Table 3 row-group label 'Alternative writing systems'; the three alternative rows are already identified in the surrounding text and separated visually from Agentic CogWriter.
Remove the redundant Table 5 row-group label 'Ablations'; NoGoals and FixedOrder are already defined as the two pre-specified ablations in the surrounding manuscript.

Remove the redundant Table 5 row-group label 'Bundled execution diagnostic' while retaining the separator before SingleWriter; the manuscript already defines SingleWriter as diagnostic rather than a clean ablation.
Remove the redundant Table 6 row-group label 'Complete process paths'; the caption already states that the first two rows partition complete process paths.

Remove the redundant Table 6 row-group label 'Non-exclusive indicators' but preserve a visible rule separating the complete-path rows from the non-exclusive indicators so the table structure remains legible.

Make the Table 7 caption standalone by naming the two process-path groups explicitly instead of beginning with the anaphoric 'Both process-path groups'. Preserve the aggregation definition and observational-not-causal qualifier.
replacements.before: \caption{Both process-path groups have similar win rates against \condFixedOrder\ and \condSingleWriter. Rates use wins and losses summed over benchmarks and all three runs within each group and comparison. The split is observational, not causal.}
replacements.after: \caption{Planning--drafting--reviewing runs and other-path runs have similar win rates against \condFixedOrder\ and \condSingleWriter. Rates use wins and losses summed over benchmarks and all three runs within each group and comparison. The split is observational, not causal.}
